info.name: Corridor
info.description: Corridor ADFS to Okta migration demo: API smoke and flow suite against the local simulation services (okta-sim 8080, portal 5200, legacy TraceLink 8000). Synthetic data only; every secret here is a documented demo constant. Run order inside each folder is numbered; the OIDC folder must run first because it captures {{accessToken}} and {{jwt}} for the other folders. Prerequisite for the SOAP folder: the legacy service must be in Dual or Okta trust mode (the seeded default Adfs correctly rejects JWTs with cor:InvalidIdentityMode); see postman/README.md for the one-line SQL flip.
